name: Lacrimosa
source:
One day at dawn. A fire breaks out in the house of the Countess of Laprade, where rumors of witches are whispered.
The only inhabitants, the eldest son and the estate, are safe. However, he repeatedly said, "He's not here," and looked terribly upset.

At the same time, the girl was on the train alone.
It was her first time in the outside world. Her destination is the house of a duke she has never met.
Will the witch lead her to happiness? Or...?
translation:
有一天，黎明时分。拉普拉德伯爵夫人的房子发生火灾，那里流传着女巫的谣言。
唯一的居民，长子和庄园，都是安全的。然而，他反复说：“他不在这里。”并且看上去非常沮丧。

与此同时，女孩独自一人在火车上。
这是她第一次来到外面的世界。她的目的地是一位她从未见过的公爵的宅邸。
魔女会带领她走向幸福吗？或者…？
